modules.module_title: Performing Operations on conventional Milling machine

pcs.pc_description: adjust and set the speed and feed of the milling machine to achieve the job specifications
operate the machine tool controls safely and correctly, in line with operational procedures both in manual and power modes
stop the milling machine, both in normal and emergency situations correctly by following the right procedure and should be able to restart the machine after and emergency
should be able to use the milling machine accessories and attachments such as Universal Milling attachment, Slotting attachment, Circular milling attachment , Dividing head etc.

• perform various milling operations using different tools to produce components with various features. • Tool: H.S.S tools, brazed carbide tip tools, interchangeable carbide insert tools, end mill cutter, side milling cutter, T slot cutter, drills, reamers, boring tool etc. • Component Feature: facing, slotting, pocket milling, circular pocket, drilling, reaming, boring, counter boring, profile milling keyways, grooves, slots, gear cutting, helical milling or special profiles
produce components as per required quality standards and free from burrs & sharp edges
shall achieve given production targets
shall be able to apply roughing and finishing cuts, considering the effect on tool life, surface finish and dimensional accuracy
shall be able to use coolants/ cutting fluids for different combinations of work piece and tool as per different locations
shall be able to observe and report any difficulties/ discrepancies that may arise during the machine operation and carry out the corrective actions as per instructions
correctly shutting down the machine on completion of the machining operations, removing and disposing of the chips/ waste and critical parameters different locations
use of measuring instruments/ gauges to check the critical parameters
shall be able to carry out the corrective action, in the case of deviation from the required specifications
report the problem to the supervisor, if it cannot be resolved.
seek guidance from the supervisor/ specialist of the problem is outside his/her area of competence

modules.module_title: Preparing for programming CNC Milling machine for production

pcs.pc_description: ensure availability of job specification i.e. approved drawings, sketches, instructions from the supervisor, job instruction sheet/ job card
read and establish job requirements from the job specification document accurately
follow job instructions, assembly drawings and laid down procedures at all times
report and rectify incorrect and inconsistent information in job specification documents as per organization procedures
use and extract information from reference charts, tables, graphs and standards
prepare the work area as per procedure or operational specification
conduct a preliminary check of the readiness of the program so that the CNC machine operates correctly

determine what operational objectives and targets need to be achieved and how best the machine needs to be programmed to achieve this CNC programming operations: preparing, loading, storing in appropriate format, proving the part program, trial runs
extract and use information from engineering drawings and related specifications in relation to work undertaken
identify tool requirements from tooling layout and assess their suitability
identify suitable workholding or fixturing device as per the job requirement
ensure the correct and latest part-program is uploaded onto the CNC system

modules.module_title: Carrying out programming for CNC Milling machine

pcs.pc_description: make the CNC program with commands for tool motions, spindle motions, miscellaneous functions and tool change, in syntax corresponding to the machine and control system on which the component will be machined

various ways to make CNC program are by writing it on paper or in a computer's text editor, or using CAM software or controllers on machine Ways: written, directly entered into the machine controller, using computer software- CAM software
• ensure that the part program is efficient and results in minimal cycle time, with • optimal cutting parameters and no unnecessary tool motions
use subprograms and canned cycles, to reduce program size and input time and avoid memory overflow on the machine
transfer the program to the machine by entering it at the console or transmitting it through a wired link or through a data transfer device
follow the correct procedures for calling up the program and dealing with any error messages or faults
handle the typical problems that can occur with the programming, loading and editing activities effectively using approved procedures
save the proven program in the appropriate storage medium – paper, computer hard disk, etc. - and location
complete relevant documentation as per organizational procedure
leave the work area in a safe and tidy condition on completion of the activities

modules.module_title: Test and prove the program on the CNC Milling Machine

pcs.pc_description: obtain appropriate equipment or tools needed as per job requirements
ensure that all measuring equipment is calibrated and approved for usage
ensure that the tools and fixtures are in usable condition(eg. free from breakage, damage, calibration, etc.)
pre-set the tooling appropriately using setting jigs/fixtures
seek any necessary instruction/training on the operation of the machine where required
mount tools in the correct positions in the tool turret or magazine
check that the tools have been mounted in positions corresponding to tool numbers in the part program
mount the part on machine firmly in the specified work holding devices, with the appropriate clamping forces.
enter work offset and tool data on the machine – X and Z offsets, tool orientation and LOe radius for lathes; length offsets and tool radius for machining centers
ensure that tool data has been entered in offset number corresponding to the tool offset numbers in the part program
deal with error messages and faults on the program or equipment
cut a trial part using single block run, dry run and feed and speed override controls
edit the program and adjust tool and wear offsets to correct any dimensional errors on the part
ensure that the trial part conforms to drawing specifications in terms of dimensions, surface finishes and geometrical parameters like concentricity, parallelism, runout, etc.
correct the tool wear offsets whenever required, based on the results of the period inspection
change worn out tools and indexable inserts whenever required
after every change of a worn out tool or insert, cut a trial part and correct any dimensional inaccuracies by adjusting the tool offsets or wear offsets
return worn out cutting tools, workholding device / fixtures / instruments / drawings to store
ensure that there is no damage to the tool/fixture while doing the prove-out
shut down the equipment to a safe condition on conclusion of the activities
deal promptly and effectively with problems within span of responsibility and control and report those that cannot be solved

modules.module_title: Performing Operations on CNC milling machine

pcs.pc_description: use and extract information from engineering drawings, dimensioning and tolerances
use and extract information from reference charts, tables, graphs and Engineering standards
load and unload component(s) using pre- determined fixtures or work holding devices as per work instructions
make basic program and check correctness of program through dry run and single block check

stop the CNC milling machine, both in normal and emergency situations correctly by following the right procedure and should be able to restart the machine after the emergency
do first part cutting trial by setting tool offsets to get oversize part
measure the critical parameters of the machined component on machine (without removing from the machine ), after the trial run

observe for inconsistency in dimensions due to tool wear and correct the offsets accordingly

report problems and seek appropriate assistance in a timely manner
